enabled.description: Enable the optional Private Companion bridge

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait for the phone observation

include_screen.description: Allow Operit to inspect the current app during proactive companion generation

autonomous_decision_enabled.description: Let the companion decide whether a proactive message is worth sending

autonomous_decision_mode.description: Autonomy mode: preview or low_risk_auto; phone control always requires confirmation

decision_cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum interval between autonomous relationship messages per user

decision_daily_limit.description: Maximum autonomous relationship messages per user per day

decision_eval_daily_limit.description: Maximum model evaluations per user per day; bounds the cost of repeated no_action

decision_eval_min_interval_seconds.description: Minimum gap between autonomy evaluations for the same user

decision_reservation_ttl_seconds.description: How long a held send slot stays reserved before it is treated as unknown

quiet_hours.description: Do not initiate autonomous messages during this local-time window

autonomy_initiative.description: How readily the companion initiates contact, from 0 to 100

autonomy_intimacy.description: Relationship warmth for autonomous decisions, from 0 to 100

allowed_user_ids.description: Explicit primary-user allowlist; empty means no user is observed

romance_intensity.description: Tone level: soft, warm, firm, bold, or devoted

pet_name.description: Optional occasional affectionate name; leave empty for natural no-name phrasing

enable_playful_jealousy.description: Allow playful jealousy based on coarse phone activity

enable_health_care.description: Use sleep and activity summaries as caring context

enable_daily_rituals.description: Add morning, evening, and late-night relationship rituals

force_affectionate_coda.description: Append an occasional stronger relationship-style closing to proactive messages

affection_coda_cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum interval between forced affectionate closings

allow_fictional_touch.description: Allow fictional affectionate gestures in relationship-style text

screen_cache_seconds.description: Reuse a coarse phone observation for this many seconds

health_cache_seconds.description: Reuse a health snapshot for this many seconds

decision_budget_path.description: Persistent decision budget file (per-user daily send/eval counts). Empty uses the default plugin data path.

care_status_path.description: Read-only care snapshot served to the app through the phone plugin's /app/state. Empty uses the default plugin data path; must match the phone plugin's care_status_path.
